# 2012B Question 15 {.unnumbered}

::: {.exam-question}
## Question {.question-label}

[**Describe**]{.task-verb} the fuel sources used during early and sustained fasting in humans.
:::

:::: {#answer-structure}

## Suggested Structure

[**Describe**]{.task-verb} **Early Fasting** and **Sustained Fasting**, relating the available substrates to their use as fuel. Use the time course to organise changes in glycogen use, gluconeogenesis, lipolysis and ketone production.

::::

## Examiner Comments

::: {.examiner-comments}
**63 %** of candidates passed this question.

This is a repeated question, and a detailed discussion in the September 2001 Examination report clearly outlines an answer.

In this exam, some candidates failed to appreciate that fasting is a natural daily occurrence that is well tolerated. Water was not considered a fuel, but marks were awarded for appreciating that fasting may be prolonged by water intake.
:::
